businesses.business: acute care and behavioral health hospitals

offering_description.value: Owns and operates acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities, and ambulatory centers. Serves patients, mostly through insurer and government reimbursement. Delivers inpatient, outpatient and emergency care at its own facilities.

primary_services.value: acute care hospital services; inpatient behavioral health treatment; outpatient and ambulatory surgery; emergency care

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients receiving hospital and behavioral health care; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs paying for patient care; B2B: commercial health insurers and managed care payers

end_markets.value: healthcare; behavioral health; hospitals; ambulatory surgery

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurers and patients for inpatient and outpatient care

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities and surgery centers serving patients; service provider: delivers clinical care using physicians, nurses and medical supplies

geography_served.value: global: United States and United Kingdom (behavioral health), plus Puerto Rico and Washington DC

specialization.value: related lines: acute care hospitals and behavioral health facilities, plus ambulatory and outpatient centers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned hospitals, behavioral health facilities, emergency rooms and surgery centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hospital licensure, Medicare/Medicaid CMS rules, Joint Commission accreditation, state health regulators, CQC in UK
